description: This source file provides static helper functions for gateway discovery and URL generation within the OpenClaw project, encapsulating common tasks such as resolving service hosts, creating service endpoints, generating SSH targets, and forming gateway URLs with security considerations.

methods.name: resolvedServiceHost
methods.description: Resolves a service host string from a gateway model, trimming whitespace and checking for emptiness.

methods.name: resolvedServiceHost(_:)
methods.description: Resolves and trims a host string, returning nil if invalid.

methods.name: serviceEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the host and port tuple for a gateway model, resolving the service host and validating the port.

methods.name: serviceEndpoint(serviceHost:servicePort:)
methods.description: Constructs a service endpoint tuple from given host and port, validating inputs.

methods.name: sshTarget
methods.description: Generates an SSH target string (user@host[:port]) for a gateway, considering the SSH port.

methods.name: directUrl
methods.description: Generates a direct URL for connecting to the gateway, based on its service host and port.

methods.name: directGatewayUrl
methods.description: Creates a URL (ws or wss) for direct gateway access, selecting scheme based on host type.

methods.name: trimmed(_)
methods.description: Helper to trim whitespace from a string.

methods.name: isLoopbackHost(_)
methods.description: Determines if a host is a loopback address.
